evidence.tag_reference: ebis.odt and LED RGB detection frames
evidence.camera_intrinsics_status: separate visual fits for Kamera 01/cam-10 and Kamera 02/cam-11; checkerboard calibration not supplied

real_dataset_audit.annotation_convention: visible per-instance boxes, including sufficiently legible platen/sample-gap strips

machine.interior_finish: fixed blue pebbled powder-coated back/left/right chamber walls; the front solid sheet-metal door and its rounded service cover are grey, the upper shell is dark low-glare steel, and the tray/platens are bare used metal
machine.platen_geometry: two 0.40 m diameter circular steel discs, about 2.22x the 0.18 m cube edge; measured CAD still required
machine.lower_contact_face_geometry: thin full-width used-steel top face; fresh LED and all-REF IR frames show circular/radial wear, concrete residue, debris and localized reflection rather than a clean white platen
machine.lower_contact_face_surface_status: provisional bounded augmentation inferred from pass-5 fresh LED and all-REF IR pixels; measure real prevalence and BRDF before production
machine.upper_contact_face_geometry: thin dark brushed steel face inset into the upper platen underside; real LED and IR frames show a dark circular contact disc rather than a white luminous fascia
machine.platen_brdf_status: bounded same-seed trial: used-steel metallic response, broad 0.3-0.6 roughness band and procedural machining are the accepted drivers; a weak CC0 Metal038 scratch/roughness contribution is retained but was visually negligible and is not evidence of a better match. Real cross-polarized BRDF capture is still required
machine.fixed_camera_stack_status: camera bodies remain virtual because the supplied frames do not expose them reliably; the large rounded grey access cover belongs to the inner face of the front door, not a fixed rear wall
machine.door_geometry: solid grey sheet-metal leaf spans the front aperture, hinges on the right vertical edge and rotates outward; zero degrees closes the front plane and positive angles move the left latch edge toward the workshop
machine.led_geometry: thin recessed three-segment opal channel following the full back+left+right walls at the upper-platen bottom level; the platen physically hides most of it
machine.workshop_backdrop: low-saturation geometry-only depth cue through the front-door opening, strongest at the left latch edge of the right-hinged leaf; unsupported red badges are omitted

sample.material_profile_status: rights-cleared cast-concrete hybrid candidate: CC0 maps contribute bounded aggregate/roughness modulation while true casting voids, mostly embedded exposed aggregate, local faceted fracture and the straight nominal silhouette remain authoritative; direct texture-strength increase failed both the pass-9 blinded crop and the pass-11 same-seed 0.54/1.05-mm candidate (only 0.3115/255 concrete-region mean absolute RGB change and no material visual gain), so geometry carries the accepted change
sample.size_status: visually fitted to real concrete bbox medians (cube about 0.49w/0.85h, cylinder about 0.26w/0.83h); confirm physical specimen and platen dimensions before production
sample.camera_conditioned_yaw_scope: calibrated for independent detection stills only; use one shared physical yaw when generating synchronized multi-camera pairs
sample.pore_scale_status: bounded visual augmentation from fresh time-diverse LED and REF IR review: dense biased-small 0.40-4.80 mm pre-damage radius range with recessed dark backings and a sparse millimetre-scale tail, kept away from nominal edges so cube/cylinder vertical silhouettes stay straight; measure specimen pore distribution before production
sample.exposed_aggregate_status: bounded mostly embedded faceted inclusions inferred from matched task-9..14 LED crops; count, colour split and 0.7-3.4 mm radius envelope are augmentation hypotheses pending macro photography and sieve/scan measurements
sample.top_load_weathering_status: bounded material-only augmentation inferred from fresh task-9..14 LED and every REF machine-camera pixel review; clustered ochre/dark residue stays mostly embedded below the upper platen, preserves the nominal specimen silhouette and is not a measured contamination prevalence or BRDF
sample.spalled_cube_notch_status: pass-11 bounded upper-front loaded-edge loss inferred from broad task-9..14 LED pixels: the one irregular convex-hull Boolean now spans 14-26% x, 14-28% y and 18-30% z; independent detection stills choose the camera-visible local-x side so the loss is not hidden behind the platen, while synchronized multi-camera generation must retain one shared physical side. 18-28 mostly embedded fracture grains break up the cavity facets. This is augmentation, not measured fracture prevalence or mechanics
sample.spalled_cylinder_cavity_status: bounded single faceted upper-side material loss with 18-26 embedded fracture grains, inferred from rare damaged cylinder frames; preserves the straight nominal sidewall outside one local 12-32 mm cavity and is not a fracture-mechanics simulation
sample.surface_regime_status: provisional bounded augmentation inferred from pass-4 fresh LED and IR pixels; measure full real prevalence before production

paper_label.colour_profile_status: bounded non-target appearance augmentation from RGB examples; orange paper remains a physical occluder and is never labeled as RFID
paper_label.surface_profile: used stained paper with fibre micro-bump, broad wrinkle normal, printed rows, non-readable handwriting and two tape strips
paper_label.geometry_scope: cube faces only until a segmented/conformed cylinder-paper mesh is calibrated
paper_label.annotation_rule: paper is a non-target physical occluder; derive one tight visible instance bbox after z-order, omit fully hidden tags, partition disconnected/low-visibility masks via the existing policy

camera_door.source_overlay: Kamera 02 / cam-11; rear-right internal fisheye looking toward the right-hinged front door and its variable left opening
camera_door.fov_status: visually estimated wide-angle profile; not calibrated

camera_angled.source_overlay: Kamera 01 / cam-10; rear-left internal fisheye looking nearly directly toward the front door
camera_angled.fov_status: visually estimated wide-angle profile; not calibrated

lens_dust.scope: subtle deterministic RGB-only out-of-focus contamination; masks and metric depth remain unchanged

camera_effects.status: visually estimated from LED frames; no checkerboard calibration
camera_effects.alignment: RGB and semantic/instance masks share lens warp; bloom and lens dust apply only to RGB; raw depth remains unwarped

annotation_policy.partition_rule: standard if every visible tag is standard; hard_occlusion if any tag is hard; exclude if any visible tag falls below hard thresholds
annotation_policy.training_rule: never mix exclude images into YOLO train; add hard_occlusion only as an explicit ablation
